requirement_digest_encoding: UTF-8, sorted object keys, compact JSON, original Unicode preserved

cases.expectation: All valid structured fixtures roundtrip to the same canonical Program.
Preserve root, stage, input, step, Result and Effect metadata.
Preserve parameters, composite defaults and opaque bindings separately from DATA.
Preserve AFTER ACCEPTED and completion-only Receipt gating without fabricated receipts.
Retain explicit sort:[], rename:{} and drop:[] steps.
Retain unused explicit steps, including fixed windows.
Reject forward operation references and stage self-import with original source locations.
Reject a Program without nonempty root Results through ordinary admission.
Keep same-named local inputs scoped to their respective stages.
Keep legacy literal SELECT sql_source/selected/rows/answer structure.
Accept quoted Japanese identifiers and emoji comments with byte, scalar and UTF-16 positions.
Reject invalid UTF-8 and unpaired surrogates before provider I/O.
Reject double-quoted identifiers in the query profile without changing YAML.
Reject duplicate JSON body keys without collapsing them first.
Reject unknown escapes and nonfinite numbers lexically.
Lower typed @threshold to the existing parameter node, never string interpolation.
Retain the legacy YAML $threshold expression tree.
Do not treat pipe text in comments or comment delimiters in strings as syntax.
Accept exactly inclusive token, node and depth limits.
Reject one-over limits before expansion, without a partial Program.
Do not reinterpret a selected SQL frontend type error as YAML or another format.
Keep original NFC-equivalent and CRLF source ranges separate from normalized values.
Compile the independent standard/pipe orders pair to the same Program and rows o1/o3.
For x=7,y=9, SET x=y,y=x preserves alias old_x=7,old_y=9 and new x=9,y=7.
After DROP x, before.x remains 7 while unqualified x is unknown.
Reject same-list reference to newly introduced y in EXTEND x+1 AS y,y+1 AS z.
For x=1,y=100, EXTEND x+1 AS a,y+1 AS b yields a=2,b=101.
Reject EXTEND that duplicates existing column x.
Reject ambiguous unqualified id across joined sources.
LEFT JOIN keeps a NULL-key left row without matching it.
FULL USING coalesces the key while retaining original aliases and nullable contracts.
UNION ALL of [1,1,2] and [2,3] preserves [1,1,2,2,3].
UNION aligns right columns by position even when names are reversed.
INTERSECT/EXCEPT DISTINCT use typed complete-row equality including NULL.
Global aggregation of an empty relation yields one row with count=0,sum=NULL.
For x=[1,NULL,2], COUNT(x)=2 and COUNT(*)=3.
Reject ungrouped output fields instead of choosing representative rows.
HAVING filters aggregate rows without leaking original input scope.
Sort [NULL,1,2] ascending as NULL,1,2 and descending as 2,1,NULL.
Reject total-order boundaries when ORDER+LIMIT has no sufficient witness or key.
LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1 over ordered [1,2,3,4] yields [2,3].
Reject LIMIT 0 before reads or writes.
Reject parameterized LIMIT under the literal-only profile.
Reject integer literal 9007199254740993 rather than rounding.
Query CONCAT('a',NULL) yields NULL.
Explicit legacy ACTQL.CONCAT('a',NULL) yields a.
At x=0, x<>0 AND 10/x>1 preserves eager failure.
At x=0, CASE WHEN x=0 THEN 0 ELSE 10/x END yields 0 lazily.
Two references to a CTE reuse captured stage input without a fresh read.
Reject recursive/self-referencing WITH.
Reject a nonequality outer-join ON predicate rather than moving it to WHERE.
Keep RANK/DENSE_RANK peers; position completion applies only to ROW_NUMBER.
Preserve the distinct existing NULL laws of FIRST_VALUE and group FIRST.
Reject RANGE frames under the ROWS-only profile.
SELECT * retains array/vector types without exposing hidden helpers.
Reject unknown source schema instead of reading samples to infer it.
Projecting endpoints of diamond A-B-D/A-C-D preserves two A,D paths.
Two-hop WALK accepts A,B,A in a cycle.
ACYCLIC excludes paths that revisit a node.
TRAIL excludes reuse of edge A-B in A-B-A-B.
For self-loop A-A, WALK/TRAIL yield one match and ACYCLIC zero.
A zero-hop node pattern yields one length-zero match per node.
A missing business ID property filter yields no match, not membership failure.
Native traverse.start.ids with a missing ID retains membership failure.
Reject node label syntax without LABELS mapping.
Map Person explicitly to the configured type field, not an inferred property.
A NULL label field does not match and confers no canonical entity identity.
Reject edge type constraints without the static label contract.
Bounded ACYCLIC {1,2} preserves separate one-hop and two-hop paths.
Reject open quantifiers rather than filling their bound from Host limits.
Reject quantified internal edge variables as unsupported group variables.
Identical edge tuple and payload rows collapse under the existing law.
Same edge tuple with conflicting payload fails instead of creating parallel edges.
Preserve Ref-valued IDs rather than replacing them with strings or CIDs.
Reject unknown graph properties even on an empty matching input.
Do not hoist hop predicates onto unrelated nodes that would fail.
Preserve demanded failure in a prefix even when a later hop removes that path.
Fail bounded temporary-binding overflow without publishing partial output.
Reject projecting a graph variable as a generic value.
Native/alias number_sum union of identical value 2 yields 4, not idempotent 2.
Applying graph_diff(A,B) to another base C fails.
NEAREST with two queries and k=1 yields up to two rows, not one globally.
L2 distance between [0,0] and [3,4] is 5, not score -5.
Equal-score candidate IDs b,a choose a under the existing tie law.
Reject vector dimension 2 versus 3 mismatch.
Preserve existing metric zero-vector and NULL laws.
NEAREST uses the filtered corpus, not the original source.
ANN acquisition plus exact reranking retains partial coverage and is not full exact search.
Reject NEAREST APPROXIMATE as a pure computation.
Explicit metadata join preserves rank/identity without inventing authority.
Structural OP merge_rankings roundtrip preserves input list order and RRF/score laws.
TUMBLE 5m assigns time 300000 to the next window.
HOP 10m step5m gives two memberships and retains negative starts.
TUMBLE 5m assigns time -1 to [-300000,0).
Retain a 60000ms window-grid offset.
SESSION gap30m separates events exactly 1800000ms apart.
Equal-time sequence events use typed ID order 1,2, not arrival order.
Reject duplicate event IDs before sequence/session.
ADJACENT A B does not match A@0,X@1,B@2.
SUBSEQUENCE A B matches A@0,X@1,B@2 once.
ALLOW over A@0,A@1,B@2 returns both matches.
DISALLOW chooses the earliest complete A0,B2 match.
WITHIN30m includes the exact 1800000ms boundary.
Reject a one-element pattern; at least two labels are required.
Reject regex quantification in PATTERN(A B+ C).
Reject timestamp sequence clocks where numeric milliseconds are required.
At the watermark threshold, late=false.
Reject source AS OF as temporal snapshots, not asof_join.
Reject CHANGES/SUBSCRIBE pending temporal semantics.
Reject SESSION output-field collision with session_start_ms.
Reject Graph to WINDOW carrier mismatch without an implicit bridge.
Check/explain causes zero provider, model and write calls.
INFER mapped to title sends title only, not secret/helper fields.
Reject non-success infer value access before outcome refinement.
Reversing peer Effect declarations does not create sequencing.
Default completed stage gating does not notify before update completion.
AFTER ACCEPTED does not manufacture a completion-only Receipt.
Recovery retains failed/unknown Effect receipts without treating them as success or reissuing all.
Reject INSERT without an explicit Program ID.
Reject INSERT without WriteTarget mapping; do not infer write aliases from read aliases.
Three requested INSERT rows with one unknown outcome are not three confirmed successes.
Delivery retry after successful Effect does not reexecute that Effect.
Reject pipe EFFECT and scalar infer at their explicit boundaries.
Reject unknown OP/raw HTTP without Host forwarding.
Across JS/Wasm/native, JSON/YAML/STEP yield the same Program CID under the same pins.
Across targets, SQL/Pipe generate the same Program; source digests may differ.
Whitespace/comment-only changes preserve Program while positions refer to the original source.
Preserve meaningful identity changes from Program ID or Effect name changes.
Grammar Manifest changes distinguish affected Plan preimages; do not claim every identity unchanged.
Replay fixed captured SUM/AVG observations without recomputation.
Reject forged generated-AST usage by actual admission accounting.
Fail one-over CTE/pattern/symbol expansion without returning a partial Program.
Generate deterministic noncolliding helper names without reserved-name exceptions.
Use registered ordinary CLI/TS/Python/Wasmtime Host paths with normal Result/Receipt contracts.
A Python-only environment does not require Node or a subprocess for raw source.
Reject unsupported Host family profiles before execution, without opaque substitute code.
Distinguish frontend not installed from runtime unsupported.
Doctor detects installed Skill/CLI Grammar Manifest mismatch.
Report warm 10KiB frontend overhead against admission+10ms p95 target, cold separately.
Keep release incomplete while required cases are not_run or skipped.
